ξεινήϊον.definition: only found in Ion. and Ep. form, host's gift to a guest, in full Od.24.273; ironically, 22.290; also, provision made for a guest, 4.33: more generally, gifts of friendship, Il.6.218

ξένος.definition: Ep. and Ion. (also freq. in; guest-friend, applied to persons and states bound by a treaty or tie of hospitality, Od.1.313, etc. ; . . 15.196; Il.6.215; Od.1.187; 17.522; later freq. coupled with D.21.110, cf. 18.46, …

ξερόν.definition: terra firma, once in Hom., Od.5.402; to the mainland, AP6.304 , cf. A.R.3.322; Nic.Th.704

ξηρότης.definition: drought, Plu.2.687f; drying or becoming dry, Arist.Mete.361b22

ξίφος.definition: power of life and death, Lat. jus gladii, Philostr.VA4.42; sword-shaped bone in the cuttle-fish , Arist.HA524b24, PA654a21, Opp.H.3.558; also in the Arist.Fr.325

ξυνήϊος.definition: Ep. and Ion. , common : neut. pl. common stock, Il.1.124, 23.809

ξύνημα.definition: javelin-throwing on horseback while on the wheel, Celtic word, Arr.Tact.42.4

ξυνήων.definition: as Adj., the salt on the common table, Alex.Aet.3.15

ξυστίς.definition: robe of rich and soft material; = Epich.97, Diph.52. fabric, such as fustian, plush, velvet, etc. ; cf. IV, 3 : for the semantic relation between and , and cf. ONorse skrúd 'some kind of textile fabric', skrúd-kloedi …

ξῦστρον.definition: scythe fixed to chariots, D.S.17.53; = BSA27.228 : condemned by Thom.Mag.p.252 R

ξαίνω.definition: of cloth, full, dress it, Ar.Av.l.c; metaph., thresh, dub. in A.Fr.304.7 ; fret, mangle, of waves, AP6.223 , cf. 23; fretted into foam, A.R.4.1266; of bodies, mangle, lacerate, D.H.3.30; esp. of flogging, ibid. ; Plu.…

ξανθίζω.definition: make yellow or brown, by roasting or; intr., to be yellow, LXXLe.13.30; Alciphr.Fr.5.4

ξάνθιον.definition: a plant used for dyeing the hair yellow

ξάνθισμα.definition: that which is dyed yellow, dyed hair, E.Fr.322, cf. AP5.259

ξανθόω.definition: dye yellow, Ps.-Democr.Alch.p.52 B.:—Pass., become yellow, Dsc.1.68

ξεναγέτης.definition: one who takes charge of guests, the hospitable Delphians, Pi.N.7.43

ξεναγέω.definition: to be a leader of mercenaries; guide strangers, show them the sights, your work as a guide has been done excellently, Pl.Phdr.230c; one seeing the sights, ibid. ; Luc.DMort.18.1, cf. Cont.I : metaph., generally, guide…

ξεναγία.definition: office of command of a body of; = Ael.Tact.9.4, Arr.Tact.10.3

ξενίζω.definition: Ion. and Ep. fut. later; surprise, astonish by some strange sight, Plb.3.114.4; of strange words, Hld.6.14; Gp.2.48.2; do violence to the ordinary use of language, Simp.in Cael.679.28:—Pass., to be astonished, S.Ichn.…

ξενολογέω.definition: enlist foreign troops, esp. mercenaries; metaph., raise a contribution of pity, D.S.34/5.2.39

ξενοφόνος.definition: poet. murdering strangers; honour paid to murderers of strangers, E.IT776

ξενοφύλαξ.definition: in pl., magistrates charged with the protection of foreigners, Rev.Et. Gr.42.35

ξενόω.definition: Ion. make one's friend and; mostly in Pass., with fut. Med. S.Ph.303: pf. aor

ξέσμα.definition: that which is smoothed or; abrasion, in pl., Jul.Caes.309c

ξέω.definition: impf. Od.23.199: fut. Paul.Aeg.3.22.12; carve wood, shape by carving, Od.23.199; Simon.l.c.:—Pass., Hld.l.c

ξηραίνω.definition: drain dry, Th.1.109; metaph., Telesp.34 H

ξηρόμυρον.definition: dry perfume, i.e. in cake or powder; = rosmarinum, Gloss

ξιφίας.definition: sword fish, Arist.HA505a18; a kind of comet , Plin.HN 2.89

ξίφιον.definition: or corn-flag, Gladiolus segetum, Thphr.HP6.8.1, Dsc.4.20

ξόανον.definition: image carved of wood, E.Ion1403; musical instrument, S.Fr.238

ξυλεία.definition: felling and carrying of wood; timber, Plb.3.42.3

ξυλοπέδη.definition: log of wood tied to the feet, Aq.Jb.13.27,33.11

ξυλοπυρία.definition: perh. sharpening to a point with fire, Anon.in Rh.236.8

ξυλοφορέω.definition: carry wood, of a slave or mule; carry a stick, as the Cynics did, Luc.Pisc.24

ξυνοχαρής.definition: rejoicing with all alike, of Apollo, ibid

ξυνόω.definition: cause to participate, Nonn.D.17.220:—Med., = Nearch. ap. Arr.Ind.20.4, Man.2.493

ξύσμα.definition: filings, shavings, Hp.Aph.7.68; lint, Erot. s.v

ξυσμή.definition: in pl., scratchings, i.e. critical marks in; scab, as a term of abuse, Sophr.53

ξυστήρ.definition: scraper, rasp, file, Hp.VC14; part of the external ear, Gal.14.701

ξυστήριος.definition: of or for scraping: dentist's instrument for scaling teeth, Paul.Aeg.6.28

ξύστρα.definition: scraper used after bathing, Hp.Nat.Mul.42; = Archig. ap. Gal.12.620

ξύω.definition: shred, prob. in Hp.Int.37; Thphr.HP9.11.2; shape by whittling, shaving, or planing, ib.5.1.7:—Med., whittle oneself a javelin, X.l.c

ξεινοβάκχη.definition: mad for love of the stranger, of Medea, Lyc.175

ξύρησις.definition: shaving, Asclep. ap. Gal.12.413, Plu.2.352c, Archig. ap. Aët.6.28, Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.36; baldness, LXXIs.22.12

ξυλαλόη.definition: = Aët.1.131; scanned ⏑–⏑– by Heraclit. Gramm. in An.Ox.3.277

ξυλοκύμβη.definition: nickname of an ill-favoured woman, Com.Adesp.1091

ξενομανέω.definition: have a rage for foreign fashions, Plu.2.527f

ξύλινος.definition: of wood, wooden, Pi.P.3.38; metaph., wooden, AP11.275 , cf. 255

ξένισις.definition: entertainment of a guest or stranger, Th.6.46

ξυλοειδής.definition: like wood, Clytus I; wooden, PSI5.547.15, al

ξενοδαίτης.definition: Dor. one that devours guests or strangers, of the Cyclops, Id.Cyc.658

ξυστροειδής.definition: shaped like a Erot.s.v. Procl.in Euc.pp.127,238 F

ξεναγός.definition: commander of mercenary; commander of a I.2, Ael.Tact.9.4, Arr.Tact.10.3

ξανθόχρως.definition: = foreg., brown, of fried fish, Nausicr.2.7

ξηρολουσία.definition: taking a dry bath, i.e. in hot sand, Cass.Fel.76

ξηροφαγία.definition: eating of dry food, Chrysipp.Tyan. ap. Ath.3.113b, Gal.14.751; herbs ealen raw, Gloss

ξυλοφθόρον.definition: an insect that destroys wood, Arist.HA557b13 codd

ξοανηφόρος.definition: image-bearer: title of a play by Sophocles

ξενοφυής.definition: strange of shape or nature, Tz.H.8.579, 636

ξυλοφόριος.definition: belonging to a wood-offering, the Jewish feast of Tabernacles, J.BJ2.17.6

ξηρόφορτον.definition: weight of a cargo of fruit after drying, OGI629.164

ξένη.definition: foreign woman, A.Ag.950, etc; foreign country, S.Ph.135; X.Lac.14.4; Phld.Rh.2.146S., cf. Plu.2.576c, etc

ξυστιδωτός.definition: garment with ornament in strigil form , IG22.1514.11
